Documentation

How to Use Verity

Verity helps you organize receipts, invoices, warranties, financial documents, and purchase records in one secure central location. Learn how to capture, organize, search, and manage your data.

1. Getting Started

To begin using Verity, create an account using one of our supported single sign-on (SSO) authentication providers. Once authenticated, you will be redirected to your personal dashboard.

The dashboard serves as your central command hub—displaying recent uploads, quick metrics, pending review items, and primary navigation controls.

2. Adding a Record

Records can be introduced into Verity in three ways:

  • Document Upload: Drag and drop or select images (JPG, PNG) or PDFs.
  • Manual Entry: Manually input transaction details without uploading a file.
  • Bank Sync: Automatically import posted transactions via connected financial institutions.

Automated Information Extraction

When uploading a document, Verity processes the file using AI to identify key fields: merchant name, transaction date, total amount, currency, category, and line items. AI-extracted data is designed as a starter draft—always review records when accuracy matters for legal or tax purposes.

3. Organizing Records

Maintain full control over your document collection through flexible organizational tools:

  • Folders & Categories: Group records by custom project, entity, or taxonomy.
  • Filtering & Edits: Filter views by date range, merchant, or price bracket, and edit metadata at any time.
  • Archiving: Hide settled or old records from primary views without deleting historical data.

4. Financial Transactions

When you connect a financial account, transaction feeds are regularly synced. Verity uses transaction metadata (such as merchant name and date) to help automatically match physical receipts to bank records.

Note: Imported transactions originate directly from external financial institutions. Verity does not control or guarantee the accuracy or timeliness of provider feeds.

5. Receipts and Supporting Documents

Attach secondary attachments (such as user manuals, return shipping labels, or communication threads) directly to a primary purchase record so all related files stay tied together.

6. Expiry Dates and Reminders

Track warranty periods, return windows, and subscription renewal dates. Set notification leads (e.g., 7 days prior) to receive timely notifications before warranties expire.

7. Search

Quickly retrieve documents using search parameters across merchant names, notes, categories, line item descriptions, and OCR-parsed document text.

8. Exporting Data

Export tabular data and metadata to standardized CSV or Excel formats at any time. This allows seamless integration with tax preparation tools, spreadsheeting software, or personal archives.

9. Managing Your Data

You own your data. You can edit entries, soft-archive inactive items, permanently remove specific records, or trigger a full account deletion directly from your account settings.

10. Privacy and Security

Verity enforces modern web security standards, strict access controls, and encrypted data transfers. Review our full Privacy Policy for granular details on data handling.

11. Tips for Getting the Most Out of Verity

  • Upload receipt photos immediately at point-of-sale to avoid lost physical copies.
  • Review AI-extracted totals prior to finalizing tax records.
  • Establish consistent folder hierarchy rules (e.g., organize by tax year or home projects).
  • Attach warranty certificates directly to high-value hardware purchases.
  • Utilize CSV exports periodically for personal offline backups.
